zh.title: Norse Atlantic 航空 11 月 26 日停飛所有航班，尋求短期融資
zh.summary: 挪威航空公司 Norse Atlantic 暫停當日所有航班。董事會表示，若無法儘快取得短期資金，將聲請破產。
body: Norse Atlantic 航空於 11 月 26 日上午公告，暫停當日全部航班，等待公司確認能否籌得維持營運所需的短期資金。公司向旅客致歉，公告未載明復飛時間。
Norse Atlantic 表示，正與投資人討論收購公司的可能性，方案將包含融資安排。董事會表示，若無法儘快取得短期融資，將聲請破產；這是資金未到位時的打算，並非已提出聲請。

en.title: Norse Atlantic Airways suspends all flights on November 26 as it seeks financing
en.summary: The Norwegian airline suspended all flights for the day. Its board said it intends to file for bankruptcy if it cannot secure short-term financing urgently.
body: Norse Atlantic Airways said on November 26 that it had suspended all flights that day while it assessed whether it could secure short-term financing. The airline apologised to passengers and did not give a time for flights to resume.

The company is discussing a possible takeover with investors that would include financing. Its board said it intends to file for bankruptcy if funding cannot be secured urgently; it did not announce a bankruptcy filing.

facts.claim: 11 月 26 日公司宣布暫停當日全部航班，等待短期融資方案明朗。
公司向旅客致歉，公告未提供復飛時間。
公司正與投資人商談可能收購案，方案將包含融資。
若短期融資無法及時到位，董事會打算聲請破產，未宣布已聲請。
